task: Add desktop user controls for multi-CLI setup, mode presets, and decision inbox answers.

resource_risks.description: The answer command writes to the shared human decision inbox and must stay inside the workspace boundary.
resource_risks.mitigation: The command resolves `_ops/coordination/human-decision-inbox.json` through the canonical workspace root and runs ensure_workspace_path before reading or writing.

resource_risks.description: A user answer could be large enough to bloat the decision inbox or UI state.
resource_risks.mitigation: The Tauri answer command rejects answers larger than MAX_DECISION_ANSWER_BYTES, currently 20,000 bytes.

resource_risks.description: Showing CLI setup guidance could accidentally become automatic global installation or unmanaged process execution.
resource_risks.mitigation: The UI only displays install hints, source URLs, and verification commands. It does not execute install commands.

resource_risks.description: Existing CLI sessions use stdout/stderr reader threads and bounded buffers; new UI must not weaken that lifecycle.
resource_risks.mitigation: This slice did not add new long-running reader threads. Existing session lifecycle still uses bounded output limits, polling, cancel, timeout, and defer controls.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: list_human_decision_inbox reads the JSON file; answer_human_decision reads, mutates one decision, appends decision_history, and writes pretty JSON.
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: No persistent file handle is retained after command return; no background worker is created.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: React renders static setup and verify command text for each adapter.
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: No subprocess, package manager, or installer is started by this UI path.

measurement_checks.threshold: MAX_DECISION_ANSWER_BYTES is 20,000 and answer_human_decision is included in readiness checks.
MAX_SESSION_OUTPUT_BYTES remains 100,000 and platform desktop tests pass.

notes: The existing static server for workspace-monitor/out remained a simple local preview server; this slice did not add a new persistent server.
